name: flow_screens_use_painted_pieces
description: The screens outside a match draw with the console's painted pieces, never flat debug boxes (AGENTS.md, design 3.7): the theme's text fields are the painted field and, focused, field_focus; its rules the divider; the Join panel, the first launch's name prompt and the Builders screen's kit plate stand on the large panel with its jewel; loading cards are card frames (mine lit), all of one width however long a name, and the loading bars are the painted trough and fill.

steps.msg: text fields are the painted field, lit when focused
rules are the painted divider, at its height
the first launch's name prompt stands on the panel, crowned by its jewel
and the Builders screen's kit plate
loading cards are the painted card frames, mine lit

steps.assert: Session.get_node('LoadingScreen').find_child('Card1', true, false).size.x == Session.get_node('LoadingScreen').find_child('Card2', true, false).size.x and Session.get_node('LoadingScreen').find_child('Card2', true, false).size.x == Session.get_node('LoadingScreen').find_child('Card3', true, false).size.x
steps.msg: every card one width, Bartholomew Wynn's too
a long name ends in an ellipsis inside its card

steps.assert: Session.get_node('LoadingScreen').find_child('Card3', true, false).get_node('Box/Bar').visible and Session.get_node('LoadingScreen').find_child('Card3', true, false).get_node('Box/Bar').trough.inner.texture.resource_path == 'res://ui/console/bar_trough.png' and Session.get_node('LoadingScreen').find_child('Card3', true, false).get_node('Box/Bar').fill.inner.texture.resource_path == 'res://ui/console/bar_fill.png'
steps.msg: the loading bar is the painted trough and fill
